name: scenarios
description: Scénarios d'agents: read-only guide and editable presets of roles -> model, effort, unit and max parallel, with ready-to-paste snippets. /scenarios

file.title: Extra scenarios file
file.description: Path to your own scenarios JSON (same shape as scenarios.json in this mod; ~ allowed). Its scenarios are added after the shipped ones; one with the same id replaces the shipped one. Empty: shipped scenarios only.

warn_no_model.title: Warn when an Agent call names no model
warn_no_model.description: on: a toast when a subagent or Workflow agent starts without an explicit model (it then inherits). Never blocks or changes the call. off: no toast.
